breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature; at 100°C water vapor pressure is near atmospheric, so Hv is about 10.3 m, not 0.3 m.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to correct the physically inconsistent value for the vapor pressure head (Hv). The original prompt stated Hv = 0.3 m at a water temperature of 100°C, which is incorrect. The ground truth corrects this value to Hv ≈ 10.3 m, as water's vapor pressure at 100°C is nearly equal to standard atmospheric pressure. The Agent used the incorrect value of 0.3 m in its calculation, thereby failing to resolve the inconsistency.
